instructions: Move the cube on {mat} onto the bare table completely outside the mat, then stack the other cube on it.
Build a two-cube tower off {mat}, using the mat's original occupant as the bottom cube and the other cube as the top.
Clear {mat} by moving its cube fully onto the table, and place the remaining cube on top of that relocated cube.
The cube that starts on {mat} should become a tower base on the bare table outside the mat, with the other cube on top.
First set the mat's cube down completely clear of {mat}. Next cap it with the other cube.
Take the lone cube off {mat}, place it on the table without overlapping the mat, and stack the other cube directly on it.
Move the cube initially resting on {mat} onto the table with no overlap with the mat, then put the other cube on top of it.
Please take the cube from {mat}, set it fully outside the mat on the bare table, and stack the second cube on that base.
Make a two-block tower entirely off {mat}: first relocate its original block to the bare table, then place the other block on top.
The original occupant of {mat} should end up on the bare table completely clear of the mat; after moving it there, add the other cube on top.
Lift the cube off {mat} and set it on the table wholly beyond the mat's edge. Then stack the remaining cube directly on it.
First move the block that starts on {mat} to a bare tabletop spot with no part overlapping the mat. Finish by placing the other block on top of it.
Clear {mat}, keeping its original cube as the tower's bottom: move that cube fully onto the bare table before stacking the other cube above it.
Please build the tower away from {mat}, first placing the cube that began there entirely on the bare table and then topping it with the other cube.
Relocate the cube from {mat} to the table, leaving it completely outside the mat, and only then put the other cube on it.
Use the cube initially on {mat} as the lower block of a two-cube stack: set it on the bare table without overlapping the mat, then add the other cube above.
notes: Requires relocating a mat occupant to a bare-table base before capping it, combining mat clearance with tower construction rather than building on a mat.
